svg.title: ArchLang is an open-source language that compiles plain-text source into floor plans. The card shows a brief given to Claude Fable and the ArchLang it wrote compiling into a dimensioned plan: 3 rooms, 31.97 m² net. Then one number is changed and the plan redraws, and a lint finding is raised and cleared. Output: SVG, PDF, DXF, PNG.
